name: Guru Brahma
text:
गुरुर्ब्रह्मा गुरुर्विष्णुः गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः ।
गुरुः साक्षात् परब्रह्म तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः ॥
meaning: The teacher represents the creative, sustaining and transformative forces. I offer respect to the teacher as a source of wisdom.
purpose: A verse of gratitude towards teachers, mentors and sources of learning.
supports: Humility; openness to learning; gratitude; respect for experience.
when: Before studying, teaching, or beginning a new learning practice.
